brief: Closes c5 and c11. updateBoat() runs a boat the length of the river, past a quay where people stand at the rail and under a bridge that every far-bank visitor walks over, and not one of them ever looks at it — the same written-but-unread shape bellUntil had, and a.listen (built at #2) is the mechanism that fits. Second, related, and verified: people DO cross the bridge (the lane is carried over the water from RIVER_X0 114 to RIVER_X1 127 at LANE_N_Y 66.4, and the `green` itinerary routes out to PARK_GATE at x=134), but no waypoint in the town ever stops anyone on it. Make the boat's passage something the town answers, and let some crossers stop at the parapet and look down.
successLooksLike: When the boat goes by, the people at the quay rail turn and follow it, and on a wide shot you sometimes catch somebody leaning on the bridge watching the water.
avoid: strikeClock owns the bell; this is a separate event and must not re-derive bellUntil. Hold nobody long — an answer that runs past ~2 s stops being an event and becomes state.
